answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 22883 Country: United States of America Title: After i had come back from hajj recently i had a dream over and over that i was kissing the hajre aswad (black stone) over and over. I seemed like the only one doing tawaf and since no one was there much i was happy on having the chance to run and kiss the black stone......and in the same dream..i was spending the night in kabatullah.........again i had a dream yesterday night that i was kissing hajre aswad...i got a chance to do it over and over again in my dream yesterday as well.......please tell me what thismeans...does this mean Allah subhanawatala has forgiven my sins? Question: After i had come back from hajj recently i had a dream over and over that i was kissing the hajre aswad (black stone) over and over...i seemed like the only one doing tawaf and since no one was there much i was happy on having the chance to run and kiss the black stone......and in the same dream..i was spending the night in kabatullah.........again i had a dream yesterday night that i was kissing hajre aswad...i got a chance to do it over and over again in my dream yesterday as well.......please tell me what thismeans...does this mean Allah subhanawatala has forgiven my sins? Answer ID: 22883 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1214/923/H=1431) Ma-sha-Allah, it is very nice dream. It means that Almighty Allah blessed you with the wealth of Hajj maqbool (accepted by Allah) and it also means forgiveness of sins. May Almighty Allah bestow you its fruits and blessings the whole life! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
